added.member: og-shape model program ops: skin, humanoid, morph; type model PBR material overrides
added.summary: Exposed `skin` (region rig `bones` and bone-heat `joints`), `humanoid` (Mixamo auto-rig + bind), and `morph` (target part, explicit deltas, or region offset/scale) ops in `.shape.json` programs, transforming skin bones across placements and unit scaling. Extended `type model` `material` override blocks with `normalMap`, `normalScale`, `roughnessMap`/`metalnessMap`, `emissiveMap`, `aoMap`, `aoMapIntensity`, `emissiveIntensity`, `clearcoat`, `clearcoatRoughness`, `sheen`, `sheenRoughness`, `transmission`, `iridescence`, `alphaTest`, `transparent`, and `doubleSided`.

added.member: type shader hooks: surface_roughness, surface_metalness, surface_ao; type post camera uniforms & HLSL validation
added.summary: Added `surface_roughness`, `surface_metalness`, and `surface_ao` hooks to material shaders (lit, prepass, physical, and scatter passes), exposed `inv_view_proj` and `camera_pos` on `PostInput` in custom post passes, and enabled HLSL (DX12, SM 6.0) naga validation in `validate_shader` and `validate_post`.

added.member: type sfx declarative synth DSL (layer / synth blocks)
added.summary: Extended `type sfx` `.ogt` files to support custom multi-layer `layer` / `synth` blocks (standalone or layered over a `preset`) with `sine`/`square`/`saw`/`triangle`/`noise` oscillators, `freq_end` sweeps, full ADSR envelopes (`sustain_level`, `release`), FM modulation (`fm_freq`, `fm_index`), resonant 2-pole SVF low-pass (`q`), and soft-clip `drive`, keeping all 18 built-in presets bit-identical.

fixed.member: og style check-project skinned model texel density
fixed.summary: Fixed `measure_model` to place triangles through `CookedModel::node_draws` (bind-pose `skin_binds` for skinned meshes and GPU-instancing transforms) instead of raw node world matrices, eliminating the 100x texel-density over-reporting on rigged characters under scaled Armatures.
